policy.identity: Character IDs, canonical names, images, stats, skills, rewards and all saved snapshots unchanged. New names belong only to contextual presentation.
policy.quest: Title is a scene, strategy stays in hint. No automatic title fallback to hint.
policy.encounter: Event title primary; boss canonical name and area separate. Same boss has one identifiable event title across areas, level/area show variants.
policy.invasion: Castle primary; phase title and lord/guard/support role separate; random enemy is never called castle lord.
